page.layout: One page of text in a single column; faint show-through of the facing page's notes in the right margin, not transcribed.

main_text.p:
Conuulsiuum facit:
Neruorum tensio, coniuncto vniuerso ner-norum genere cum arteryis, propter commu-nem affectum.

Tremulum:
Facultas imbecilla.
Arteria mollis. &,
Corporis gracilis habitus.

Serrantem, uel secantem, uel serratum:
Arteriarum durities ex inflammatione, & earundem intemperies, in vno occursu inaequales.

Pulsum hecticum:
Febris, quae corporis occupauit uniuersum habitum.

Quales fiant ab externis causis pulsuum mutationes,
Ex libro de pulsibus, ad eos qui introducun-tur, tibi est perdiscendum.
main_text.head: DE PVLSVVM IVDICIIS, vel praenidentijs.
main_text.p:
Pulsus magnus, nō uno dicitur modo. Nempe,
AVT ad moderatum comparatus:
Aut ad naturalem cuiusque.
Magnus

page.notes: The initial A of "AVT" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word. The catchword-like word "Magnus" at the foot right is a signature-style catchword as printed. Show-through of the facing page is present in the right margin and not transcribed. Some lines in the right margin are too faint to read.
